name: Matreier Tauernhaus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Matreier Tauernhaus in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Hohe Tauern**, the **Matreier Tauernhaus** invites you to experience the unspoiled beauty of **Tirol**’s wild mountains. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy alpine retreat offers breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** and the **Kitzbühel Alps**, where the **Ötztal** and **Pitztal** valleys stretch out like a painter’s canvas.

### **A Taste of Tirol**
Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** cuisine—think crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** dusted with powdered sugar, rich **Tiroler Gröstl** (a rustic potato and meat hash), and slow-cooked **Kaspressknödel** (cheese dumplings) served with tangy **Tiroler Bergkäse**. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein** or a warming **Glühwein** by the crackling fireplace.

### **Adventure Awaits**
Whether you’re hiking the **Matreier Tauern** trails, skiing the slopes of **Skicircus Zillertal Arena**, or simply soaking in the **Therme Längenfeld**, the **Matreier Tauernhaus** is your gateway to unforgettable alpine experiences. The **Zillertal** and **Ötztal** regions are just minutes away, offering world-class skiing, mountain biking, and hiking in every season.

### **Relax & Unwind**
After a day of exploration, unwind in our rustic yet modern rooms, each with a view of the towering peaks. The **Tauernhaus** also features a cozy **Stüberl** (traditional tavern) where you can enjoy live **Tiroler** music and local crafts.

### **Plan Your Stay**
Located in the serene village of **Matrei am Brenner**, the **Matreier Tauernhaus** is easily accessible via the **Brenner Pass** (Brennerautobahn, A13). Whether you’re seeking adventure, relaxation, or a taste of **Tiroler** hospitality, this alpine gem promises an authentic escape into the heart of the **Alps**.

**Come and discover why Tirol is more than just a destination—it’s a feeling.**
